caption: The drawing features three objects arranged vertically on a plain, beige background. At the top is an outlined, rectangular brooch design rendered in black and white, showcasing a simple border with small circles. In the middle is a large, rectangular bar-shaped brooch, predominantly colored in dark gray or black, with a golden-yellow decorative border forming loops around the edges. At the center of this brooch is a golden-yellow leaf motif, with a detailed, layered flower in orange and yellow tones superimposed on the leaves. The bottom object is a smaller, narrower bar-shaped piece, colored mainly in black, with a golden-yellow dotted border and a small central golden flower similar to the motif on the larger brooch. The artist's name, "Tulita Westfall," is written in faint, capital letters at the bottom left of the composition.
title: Pin
